text:
jenna (PMM): ok folks — need a tight sales one-pager & a short benchmark blurb for enterprise prospects. focus: VPC/private deploy + SLA guarantees + security/KMS story. target: AEs and pre-sales.

sam (SE): putting together 1) security bullets 2) SLA language 3) quick benchmark numbers. i'll draft and share link.

teresa (AE): pls make sure the top-line value is clear: predictable latency + auditability. AEs need an elevator pitch ~2 lines.

matt (Docs): can we avoid the word "airtight" :) also need a callout for deployment choices: Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC (on-prem).

lisa (Growth): can we include a one-sentence webinar CTA? e.g., "Join our enterprise briefing: scaling inference with SLAs & VPCs" — drives inbound.

miguel (Eng): sharing rough perf snippet for inclusion:
```
Benchmark (p50 latency, 1024 tokens): Hosted: 120ms | Dedicated (reserved GPUs): 85ms | Private-VPC (customer infra): depends on HW
Throughput: Dedicated pool sustaining 600 reqs/s on a 8xA100 pool (batched)
```

sam (SE): included security bullets draft: "Private control plane, VPC peering, customer KMS/HSM integration, audit logs with immutability, SOC2-ready controls, configurable data residency."

jenna (PMM): great. for SLAs we need exact wording — uptime % + latency thresholds + credits. teresa, do we have legal-approved SLA templating?

teresa (AE): we have standard enterprise SLA: 99.9% uptime for Dedicated, 99.5% for Hosted with optional SLA add-on. latency SLOs are per-commit and depend on model family; we can promise SLO-backed routing and fallbacks. legal ok'd the generic phrasing — i'll add the doc link.

matt (Docs): draft layout suggestion:
- Header: 2-line value prop (predictable inference economics + deployment flexibility)
- Left column: Security & compliance bullets
- Right column: SLAs + Deployment Modes + Quick benchmarks
- Bottom: CTA (webinar + contact AE + gated benchmark PDF)

lisa (Growth): +1 on gated benchmark PDF. We can route leads from the CTA directly to AE queue with inbound tag "enterprise-slas-vpc". pls include form fields: company size, deployment interest, security regs (SOC2/HIPAA), and preferred timeline.

kendra-bot: new doc created: https://redwood.internal/drive/enterprise_vpc_slas_draft_v1.md

sam (SE): uploading first draft in that doc now. small ask: include a short "migration path" box for current customers who want to move from Hosted to Dedicated or Private. helps AEs.

jenna (PMM): agreed. also add 1-line competitor differentiation: unified API across modes + transparent per-token economics + intelligent routing/fallbacks. keep it neutral.

matt (Docs): i'll assemble a printable PDF + a slide (1 slide) for AEs. target: first draft by EOD tomorrow.

teresa (AE): webinar idea: 30m "How to buy predictable inference" — 15m talk (benchmarks + SLAs) + 15m Q&A. AEs can capture leads. lisa can you own registration?

lisa (Growth): yes — i'll setup registration, target audience: infra/platform + security + ML eng. proposed date: two weeks out.

miguel (Eng): small note for the one-pager: call out KMS/HSM integrations explicitly (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, and customer HSM options). also add a line about audit log retention (configurable).

jenna (PMM): perfect. once matt posts draft, i'll iterate messaging for AE talk track and webinar blurb. goal: single-page PDF + 1-slide + gated benchmark PDF. tagging this "enterprise-slas-vpc" for routing.

teresa (AE): thanks team — i'll prep AE talking points and a short follow-up email template we can drop into the CRM.

sam (SE): uploaded draft -> https://redwood.internal/drive/enterprise_vpc_slas_draft_v1.md#section1

matt (Docs): draft posted. feedback welcome, I'll update layout and add the migration path box.

lisa (Growth): scheduling reg page and setting inbound tag. will share tracking spreadsheet once live. :rocket:

jenna (PMM): awesome. next steps: everyone review draft by EOD tomorrow. we'll sync on webinar logistics on Wed. thanks!
